text: {"assertions":["A message redelivery bug was found in worker/queue/consumer.py where the same message ID was being handled multiple times.","The bug affected clients still using the v1 SDK.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The fix involved removing the listener on teardown and adding an assertion test in PR #5939 on branch fix/message-redelivery-1.","The bug could be reproduced by killing the worker mid-batch and restarting it.","The failing test in tests/worker/test_consumer.py was resolved with the fix, improving from 80 failures per 100 runs to zero.","The work was completed on 2026-01-26 in a Python-based background jobs system."]}
